description.value: The Dayton Audio SS15-PR 15" Signature Series Passive Radiator is designed for powerful, high-output subwoofer systems where deep bass extension and clean performance are critical. Built to perfectly complement the SS15-22, this passive radiator uses the same heavy-duty cast aluminum frame, anodized aluminum cone, and rubber surround as its active counterpart, giving it the strength and excursion capability needed for today's most demanding designs. With Dayton Audio's Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) tuning system, fine-tuning your subwoofer enclosure is simple, accurate, and secure. Product Highlights Signature Series styling with cast aluminum frame, aluminum cone, and rubber surround - visually identical to the SS15-22 driver Passive radiator design enables extended low-frequency response in compact enclosures without port noise Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) places added mass between spider and surround for stability and symmetry Includes five 116 g weights for flexible tuning options Easy tuning with threaded bolt, wing nut, and nylock nut for secure adjustment Perfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS15-22 in powerful, high-output passive radiator systems
